cohort: The cohort comprised pregnant women with hypertensive disorders who received SARS-CoV-2 vaccination.
finding: Pregnant women with hypertensive disorders who were vaccinated against SARS-CoV-2 and subsequently infected showed comparable maternal and perinatal outcomes and PE biomarker levels to those who were not infected.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was the most common delivery method in both groups (those with and without COVID-19 during pregnancy), and there was a high rate of preterm births.
